Main tsconfig EXCLUDES this file; this config checks it with strictNullChecks ON. Every module the allowlist graduates into strictNullChecks moves from the main config's include to a line here (and gets added back to the main config's include ONLY after the whole project flips). Run through test/typecheck-gate.mjs, which executes both configs.
